title: Add `orchestrator status --plain`: one line per account plus one for codex
spec:
Why: evals/001-add-cli-flag.md; a terminal-friendly status for `f orch status`. Scout T-0006 located the insertion points.

What (2 files):
1. orchestrator/cli.py — at the `sub.add_parser("status")` call (cli.py:22) add `.add_argument("--plain", action="store_true")`. In the `if a.cmd == "status":` branch (cli.py:30-31): when `a.plain`, take `s = Pool().status()` and print exactly one tab-separated line per account in order: `{id}\tutil={utilization:.3f}\tcooling={cooling_s}s\treason={reason or "-"}`, then one final line `codex\tavailable={available}\trunning={running}\tday_tasks={day_tasks}\tcooling={cooling_s}s`. No JSON, no header. Otherwise keep the existing json.dumps output byte-for-byte.
2. tests/test_orchestrator.py — add class `Cli(unittest.TestCase)` with one test: patch `sys.argv = ["orchestrator", "status", "--plain"]`, capture stdout with `contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO())`, call `orchestrator.cli.main()`; assert the output has exactly 3 lines (accounts A and B from the copied pool.toml, then codex), line 1 starts with "A\tutil=", line 3 starts with "codex\tavailable=". Add a second assertion that `["orchestrator", "status"]` (no flag) still yields valid JSON with keys accounts, codex, queue. Import io/contextlib at the top only if not already imported. Follow the harness: TMP/ORCH_ROOT are set at module import; do not create new temp dirs.

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit on the task branch: "cli: status --plain, one line per account and one for codex" with a body naming the revert path.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new Cli test not skipped
uv run orchestrator status --plain prints exactly 3 lines, the last starting with 'codex\t'
uv run orchestrator status (no flag) output is unchanged JSON with keys accounts, codex, queue
git diff --stat shows only orchestrator/cli.py and tests/test_orchestrator.py

result.summary:
Summary: added `--plain` flag to `orchestrator status` (cli.py) that prints one tab-separated line per account plus a final `codex\t...` line; JSON output unchanged when the flag is absent. Added `Cli` test class covering both paths.

Files changed: `orchestrator/cli.py`, `tests/test_orchestrator.py`

Test output: `Ran 22 tests in 7.673s — OK` (no failures)

Committed on `task/T-0011` as `152bcb9`.
